title: Spain: Ceuta Under Pressure and Inflation Still Biting · 08 Sep
keywords: Spain, Ceuta, migration crisis, border security, inflation, current account, EU migration policy, Spanish economy, Morocco, energy prices, asylum, European Union, economic resilience
notes: Spain is confronting two overlapping crises that together define the country's political and economic moment: a renewed surge of migration into its North African enclave of Ceuta and stubborn inflation that continues to squeeze household budgets despite official optimism. Both developments carry consequences well beyond Spain's borders, touching EU border policy, fiscal solidarity, and the credibility of recovery narratives across the bloc. The government insists it is managing both with determination; critics say the responses expose deeper structural failures.
